metadata.title: fix(schemas): accept camelCase fields on gateway creation
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- `GatewayCreate` extended `BaseModel` directly, missing the `alias_generator=to_camel_case` and `populate_by_name=True` config that `GatewayUpdate` inherits from `BaseModelWithConfigDict`
- This caused camelCase field names (e.g. `passthroughHeaders`, `authType`, `authToken`) to be silently ignored on `POST /gateways`, while the same fields worked correctly on `PUT /gateways/{id}`
- Fix: change `GatewayCreate` to extend `BaseModelWithConfigDict`, matching `GatewayUpdate` and `AdminGatewayCreate`

Closes #3577

commits.message:
fix(schemas): accept camelCase fields on gateway creation

GatewayCreate extended BaseModel directly, lacking the alias_generator
and populate_by_name config that GatewayUpdate inherits from
BaseModelWithConfigDict. This caused camelCase field names like
passthroughHeaders to be silently ignored on POST /gateways while
working correctly on PUT /gateways/{id}.

Closes #3577

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
test(schemas): add differential tests for GatewayCreate camelCase support

Verify GatewayCreate accepts camelCase input fields (e.g. authType,
passthroughHeaders), still accepts snake_case, serializes to camelCase
with by_alias=True, and behaves consistently with GatewayUpdate.

Regression tests for #3577.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
